step.title: pfBlockerNG Components
step.description:
CAUTION BEFORE PROCEEDING!
  • The pfBlockerNG wizard will configure a default setup for pfBlockerNG.
  • This default configuration is an entry level setup which is designed to assist beginners of pfBlockerNG.
  • If you have previously configured pfBlockerNG, all settings will be wiped on completion of this wizard!
  • Two components will be installed:
IP:
Firewall rules will be added to the selected Outbound interfaces to block the worst offenders.
DNSBL:
Utilizing the DNS Resolver, ADverts and the worst known malicious domains will be blocked.
  • A VIP on the Localhost interface can be configured manually at Firewall > Virtual IPs, or pfBlockerNG can create one automatically in the DNSBL step. The DNSBL WebServer/VIP response is deprecated: the VIP is only needed while a DNSBL block answers with it.

step.title: pfBlockerNG DNSBL Component Configuration
step.description:
On this screen the pfBlockerNG DNSBL Category parameters will be set.
The DNSBL WebServer/VIP response is deprecated: the Virtual IP below is only needed while a DNSBL block answers with it.
Enable Create VIPs automatically below to have pfBlockerNG manage the DNSBL sinkhole Virtual IP, or configure a VIP on the Localhost interface manually first at Firewall > Virtual IPs.

field.name: pfb_dnsvip_auto
field.description:
Create VIPs automatically. When enabled, pfBlockerNG picks and manages the DNSBL sinkhole Virtual IP itself — the manual selections below are ignored. The address it chose is shown on the DNSBL page once the wizard finishes.
HA: with pfBlockerNG Sync in Policy scope, a secondary that also uses Auto VIP creates its VIP at the address the primary chose. If that address is in use on the secondary, no VIP is created and the Sync page reports the conflict.

field.name: pfb_dnsvip4
field.description: Select the IPv4 DNSBL Virtual IP (manual mode only — ignored when Auto VIP is enabled)

field.name: pfb_dnsvip6
field.description: Select the IPv6 DNSBL Virtual IP (manual mode only — ignored when Auto VIP is enabled)

field.name: pfb_dnsport
field.description: Local port upon which DNSBL Webserver will listen for connections. The default port is 8081. This can be left at its default unless a different port needs to be used.

field.name: pfb_dnsport_ssl
field.description: Local port upon which DNSBL Webserver will listen for connections. The default port is 8443. This can be left at its default unless a different port needs to be used.

field.name: suppression
field.description: Enable a default DNSBL Domain Whitelist. This list can be removed and/or modified following wizard installation.
